array.string: D="$HOME/.alttab-dev/AltTabCore.dylib" APP=/Applications/AltTab.app say() { mkdir -p "$HOME/.alttab-dev"; echo "$(date '+%F %T') $1" >> "$HOME/.alttab-dev/startup.log"; } if [ -f "$D" ]; then launchctl setenv ALTTAB_DYLIB_OVERRIDE "$D"; else launchctl unsetenv ALTTAB_DYLIB_OVERRIDE; say "no published dev dylib; running installed bundle"; fi P=$(pgrep -f "^$APP/Contents/MacOS/AltTab\$" | head -1) if [ -f "$D" ] && [ -n "$P" ] && ! ps eww -p "$P" | grep -qF "ALTTAB_DYLIB_OVERRIDE=$D"; then say "AltTab pid $P running without the dev override; relaunching under $D" osascript -e 'tell application id "com.lwouis.alt-tab-macos" to quit' 2>/dev/null i=0; while kill -0 "$P" 2>/dev/null && [ $i -lt 20 ]; do sleep 0.5; i=$((i+1)); done kill -9 "$P" 2>/dev/null fi if pgrep -f "^$APP/Contents/MacOS/AltTab\$" >/dev/null; then say "AltTab already running; nothing to do"; exit 0; fi i=0; until open -n "$APP" --env "ALTTAB_DYLIB_OVERRIDE=$D" || [ $i -ge 5 ]; do sleep 2; i=$((i+1)); done say "launched AltTab override=${D}"
